question: Budget and price sensitivity (sensitivity only; game prices stay ₫20/₫10, D5)

players.ORACLE: oracle manifesto + balance.policy_planner via x_batch.run_batch (true state; reference, not a player). No queries, so it is query-fee invariant: cell keys use Q'any'.
players.pattern/<p>: X0 scripted paid patterns with the informed manifesto (balance.py criterion 4), per cell
players.BayesPlanner: GameEngine games, observation dicts only; config overrides passed to engine and planner

survey_budget_rule.reason: same number of affordable questions (5) in both query-fee arms; the library default ₫50 would buy 10 questions at ₫5 and 5 at ₫10

dominant_rule: workers if ≥ 2/3 of campaign spend (workers + media) went to workers, media if ≤ 1/3, else mixed

A_workers_vs_media.family: pay_workers − pay_media expected share, 12 (treasury, worker fee) cells; Wilcoxon, Holm within family

B_diminishing_returns.family: paired (gain 500→750) − (gain 750→1000) in expected share, per player and fee column; Wilcoxon, Holm within family

C_query_fee_bayes.family: BayesPlanner query fee ₫5 − ₫10 (survey budget 5 questions in both), 12 cells; Wilcoxon, Holm within family

D_worker_fee_vs_20.family: each worker fee − ₫20 at the same treasury/query fee, per player; Wilcoxon (expected) and McNemar (wins), each Holm within family
